import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Apply fixes locally
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git fetch origin fix/esm-stable 2>&1")
print("Fetched")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git reset --hard 755b0748 2>&1 | tail -2")
print("Reset:", stdout.read().decode())
# Fix build script
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's/\"build\": \"tsc --noEmit || true\"/\"build\": \"tsc\"/' /opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("Fixed build")
# Fix CombatSystem - need to add closing paren on line 348/349
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '348p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/systems/CombatSystem.ts")
line348 = stdout.read().decode().strip()
print("Line 348:", line348)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's/FP_SCALE$/FP_SCALE)/' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/systems/CombatSystem.ts")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '348p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/systems/CombatSystem.ts")
print("Fixed line 348:", stdout.read().decode().strip())
client.close()
EOF
